question:
The following pie chart shows the different coloured dresses worn by 60 students in a college party. Study the pie chart and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02e464e6074626dc1b7a2f5405cd7497ad002fb64c82d897c3b0e74cb81e1acd.png] 

The number of students who wore a cement-colored dresses (a sector which represents 20%) is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

As given in the figure,

the students who wore cement-colored dresses are = 20 %

Number of students who wore cement-colored dresses are

⇒ 20 % of 60 = (20)/(100) times 60 = 12

**Hence, there are 12 students who are wearing a cement-colored dresses.**
